description:
## Background

Beadsmith currently defines quality commands in several places: `package.json`, `lefthook.yml`, `.config/wt.toml`, agent prompts, repository documentation, and an external Devin environment. The same gate can therefore run different tools, omit checks, or drift from the pinned lockfile. The pre-merge Worktrunk hook currently runs frontend tests and `cargo check`, but it does not run frontend linting, typechecking, Rust formatting checks, Clippy, or Rust tests. Lefthook also invokes Ultracite through `pnpm dlx`, which can resolve a version different from the repository dependency.

The repository already uses mise 2026.8.12. Its Node.js cookbook supports reading the existing `packageManager` field as the pnpm version source, and current mise successfully provisions Node 24.13.0 and pnpm 11.23.0 on macOS ARM.

## What to build

Make `mise run gate` the single, documented mergeability gate for the repository. All repo-owned gate definitions must live in `mise.toml`; hooks, Worktrunk, agents, and documentation must delegate to the canonical task graph. Keep e2e commands as scenario orchestration, not as gate definitions.

The final system must:

- provision the pinned Node, pnpm, Rust, rustfmt, and Clippy toolchain;
- run frontend lint/format checks, typechecking, and unit tests;
- run Rust format checks, Clippy, and tests;
- preserve staged-file-only behavior for pre-commit formatters;
- retain advisory React Doctor behavior at commit time;
- make new Worktrunk worktrees install their dependencies with the mise-selected pnpm;
- keep Ultracite Doctor and React Doctor distinct;
- preserve all e2e scenario scripts unchanged.

## Technical Approach

This is a wide configuration and workflow refactor. Sequence it as independently verifiable slices:

```mermaid
graph TD
  A[Green Rust quality baseline] --> C[Add canonical mise toolchain and gate]
  B[Centralize frontend quality ignores] --> C
  C --> D[Migrate Lefthook staged hooks]
  C --> E[Migrate Worktrunk lifecycle and pre-merge]
  C --> F[Remove duplicate scripts and update callers/docs]
  D --> G[Cross-environment acceptance and Devin handoff]
  E --> G
  F --> G
```

The repository-owned implementation should use a generic `scripts/mise-exec.sh` launcher only for locating the mise executable in minimal shells. It must not contain quality command definitions. The actual commands belong in mise tasks, including hook adapter tasks that accept Lefthook staged-file arguments.

Use the idiomatic mise configuration:

```toml
min_version = "2026.8.12"

[settings]
idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools = ["pnpm"]

[tools]
node = "24.13.0"
rust = { version = "1.97.1", profile = "default" }
```

The existing `packageManager` field remains the pnpm version source and checksum.

## Considerations

- The current Rust baseline is not green: `cargo fmt --check` reports existing differences and Clippy with `-D warnings` reports seven warnings. The gate cannot be called complete until this is fixed or explicitly deferred in a separate Beadwork issue.
- Clippy must use an explicit policy for test targets, preferably `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- The initial gate intentionally excludes the Vite build unless the implementation owner decides that mergeability must imply buildability.
- `mise trust` is a user security decision. Git hooks must not silently trust an untrusted repository config.
- `.agents/skills/**` remains vendored and must not be edited.
- Devin environment configuration is external to this repository and needs an explicit handoff/receipt.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All child slices are complete and their dependency edges are satisfied.
- [ ] `mise run gate` is the only repository-owned merge gate definition and passes in a clean checkout.
- [ ] Lefthook, Worktrunk, agent instructions, and repository documentation use the canonical mise tasks.
- [ ] E2E scenario scripts remain behaviorally unchanged.
- [ ] Fresh checkout, minimal-shell commit, and fresh Worktrunk setup have been verified.
- [ ] Devin’s external configuration is updated or recorded as an explicit pending handoff.

## Test Plan

- Run the full `mise run gate` in a clean checkout.
- Exercise staged TypeScript and Rust commits through Lefthook.
- Run `wt hook pre-merge` in a disposable worktree.
- Verify `mise install` and the gate from a fresh checkout and on macOS ARM.
- Review the final command inventory, distinguishing gate definitions from e2e scenarios, source comments, documentation examples, and permission allowlists.

## Triage

ready-for-agent
title: Centralize Beadsmith quality gates on mise
